decision: Reuse the native preview-public helper and existing regressions. No task-local exporter or duplicate regression suite was added.
limits: These are the existing 33 focused tests with synthetic qualification claims and real current-source/receipt validators. They perform no protected-Racket label replay, owner acceptance, or training admission. Actual MAIN native qualification and saved-view export are separate integration evidence.
verified_surfaces: Single-query visible bytes ignore private settings, programs, answers, seed, and future queries.
Public file names hash exact visible bytes and are sorted; private manifests retain query order.
Live source drift, receipt bytes/status/program-map changes and unprotected runtime claims are rejected.
Exact integer validation, ragged grids, repeated episode inputs, duplicated public views and shortened query coverage are rejected.
Source changes during serialization stop publication; existing output is preserved.
Added/modified public files, directories, source changes and reordered private mappings fail verification.
Incomplete setting/seed coverage, duplicate or boolean seeds and current semantic vetoes are rejected.
Relocated wrapper export/verify succeeds without ambient imports; supported query count is not hardcoded to four.
